sql_select_join.description: Select rows from two tables joined on a foreign key
body: INNER JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id

sql_select_subquery.description: Select with correlated subqueries used as columns
body: (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS order_count,
(SELECT MAX(o.placed_at) FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id) AS last_order_at

sql_group_by_having.description: Aggregate per group and filter the groups with having
body: JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id

sql_window_function.description: Window function with a partition, ordering and a frame clause
body: ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

sql_recursive_cte.description: Recursive CTE that walks a category tree
body: JOIN category_tree AS t ON c.parent_id = t.id

sql_insert_rows.description: Insert several rows with a multi row values list
body: INSERT INTO customers (name, email, country, created_at)

sql_insert_returning.description: Insert a single row and return the generated columns

sql_update_join.description: Update rows through a join with another table

sql_delete_rows.description: Delete rows selected through a subquery

sql_upsert.description: Insert or update a row with on conflict do update

sql_create_table.description: Create a table with types, defaults and a foreign key
body: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS orders (
customer_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
placed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()

sql_alter_table.description: Alter a table to add a column, a default and a constraint
body: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shipped_at TIMESTAMPTZ;

sql_create_index.description: Create a partial index with a descending key
body: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_placed_at

sql_unique_index.description: Unique indexes on an email and on a business key
body: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_customers_email
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_orders_reference

sql_create_view.description: Create a view that aggregates orders per customer
body: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW customer_order_totals AS
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id

sql_stored_function.description: Stored function in plpgsql that returns a computed value
body: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION customer_lifetime_value(p_customer_id BIGINT)

sql_create_trigger.description: Trigger with a plpgsql function that stamps a column

sql_transaction.description: Transaction that moves money between two tables

sql_case_expression.description: CASE expression that buckets rows into named buckets
body: CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN o.total * -1 ELSE o.total END AS signed_total

sql_null_handling.description: Null handling with coalesce, nullif and a left join
body: LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
